question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The land that is best suitable for growing crops
solution:
The correct answer is: **Arable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"arable"** refers to land that is suitable for growing crops. It is fertile and can be plowed or tilled for agricultural purposes. (कृषियोग्य भूमि)

 
 
• **Example: **The farmer purchased a large plot of arable land to expand his agricultural operations.
 
 
 
• **"Barren"**, on the other hand, means land that is not productive or fertile, and cannot be used for growing crops. (बंजर)
 
 
• **Example: **The vast desert was barren and inhospitable for farming.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate one-word substitute for "land that is best suitable for growing crops" is **"arable"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Arable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Barren** (बंजर): Land that is too poor to produce vegetation or crops.

 
 
• **Example:** The barren land was unable to sustain any kind of vegetation.
 
 
 
• **Fruitful** (फलदायक): Producing good results or benefits; productive.
 
 
• **Example:** Their fruitful discussion led to an innovative solution to the problem.
 
 
 
• **Rustic** (ग्रामीण): Relating to the countryside; simple and unsophisticated.
 
 
• **Example:** The rustic charm of the village attracted many city dwellers.
